name: Corby Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Corby Community Church. Open Tue and Fri for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: North Northamptonshire Council Allotments
short_description: North Northamptonshire Council allotment sites in Corby area
description: Council manages sites at Lodge Park and Weldon. Plots from £25/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage facilities.

name: Corby Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Lodge Park. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Open weekends during growing season.
